name: Magma Glass Slide launch / Lava Stair head
purpose: The thrill: a gallery round an open shaft where a clear glass tube spirals down past a wall of moving lava; riders cross a short bridge to the launch gate, walkers take the Lava Stair that winds round the tube, and everyone stops at the rail to look down.

ceiling_profile.note: Low carved dome over the shaft; lit orange from below by the lava glass.

spurs.note: Along the north gallery (1.6-1.7 m wide between the stair void and the wall).

hero.why: A clear glass helix dropping into a glowing shaft: the reason to come here. The lava glass on the south wall makes the water inside glow orange; the bridge, rails and lanterns all point at the tube mouth.

anchored.why: Concept 13 / B1 plan: lava behind thick glass beside the slide. Spans the room's south wall; propose it continues down the shaft's south half so the tube runs past lava all the way (coordinate with b2_lava_link and b3_slide_foot).
Crosses the Lava Stair void at bearing 270 (stair 4.8 m below there) from the west floor to the tube mouth.
Bronze start gate, grab bar and water manifold at the tube mouth.
Rail round the shaft edge, open only at the bridge and the stair head.
Inner rail on the void side of the stair-head gallery.
Waiting riders sit against the west wall facing the tube.
Board by the door: slide to B3 left, Lava Stair right.

water.note: Water runs inside the tube only (manifold at the launch gate); no open surface in this room.

sightlines.see: Through the noren: orange light, the tube mouth and bridge straight ahead, lava glass to the right.
Down the shaft: the tube spiralling past lava, the stair winding round it, lantern dots far below at B2 and B3.
From the stair head, back across the shaft to the bridge and door.

concept.match: Glass tube with bronze ribs spiralling down centre-left, the lava glass filling the right, lanterns and timber rail on the left edge, steam, everything lit orange.

lights.why: Main light; the tube in front of it glows (hero group).
A short row of chochin over the bridge leads to the gate.
Landing pair at the Lava Stair head and a pair inside the door; kept dim against the lava.
Few posts on the rail; dark gaps let the lava own the room.

dressing.why: Corners only; the shaft rim stays clear.

mood.palette: orange lava, bronze, clear glass, black basalt, a few amber lanterns
mood.mist: Steam rising out of the shaft, lit orange.

waivers.reason: The slide shaft is fixed at the H4 cell centre by layout.json.
The lava glass directly behind the tube is brighter per pixel; tube and lava read as one hero group (as concept 13).

waivers.where: north gallery to the stair head (x 143-150, y 58.3-60)
waivers.reason: 1.6-1.7 m clear between the stair void and the wall (>=1.2 m); widen by moving the north wall only if the treatment hall moves (see report).

conventions: anchored/hero 'at' = object centre on its floor; facing_deg = bearing of the asset's front (+Y). Extra keys beyond SCHEMA.md: spurs, segments, implied portals, bed_z/top_z, stagger/groups on lights, footprint on still water.
